hero.subtitle: Thoughtful, collaborative counselling for adults navigating anxiety, mood, relationships, stress, and life transitions.

approach.title: Care that is warm, grounded, and practical
approach.description: Sessions draw on person-centred, trauma-informed, and CBT-informed ideas, shaped around your goals, capacity, and what feels useful in the moment.

items.title: Person-centred
items.description: A collaborative relationship where you are met with warmth, respect, and curiosity.

items.title: Trauma-informed
items.description: Care that prioritizes safety, consent, pacing, and the wisdom of the nervous system.

items.title: CBT-informed
items.description: Practical tools for noticing patterns in thoughts, emotions, and behaviour.

services.title: Individual counselling for adults
services.description: Support for what you are carrying, with space to understand patterns, strengthen coping, and move toward what matters to you.
